name: Anzrag
description: Gruul god who broke loose and later escaped custody.

description_citations.text: "The Murders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ezrim recounts how Investigator Kellan's team stopped the god Anzrag's rampage.
timeline.quote: a Gruul god broke loose of guild control and wreaked havoc across the Ninth District.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: Yarus is dragged off the balcony shouting that Anzrag must be returned to the Gruul.
timeline.quote: Anzrag is our responsibility, our god, and he must be returned to us!

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 1: Ghosts of Our Past" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Dec 2023.

timeline.summary: The evidence room lies in ruins as Anzrag breaks free.
timeline.quote: The room containing the evidence locker lay in ruins, the walls completely shattered by the force of whatever had been released.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Anzrag emerges from the dust and smashes an agent flat.
timeline.quote: the smoke parted as its occupant lunged forward, massive, spatulate front paws slamming into the floor.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan identifies the creature as the Gruul harvest god Anzrag.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Several agents are killed or injured as Anzrag rampages and Kaya leaps onto him.
timeline.quote: At least four people were down, two buried under chunks of masonry, one flattened by the god, and one sliced nearly in two by her claws.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya stabs Anzrag's nose while Kellan slashes his forelegs.
timeline.quote: Kaya struck him square in the middle of the tendril starburst, daggers biting deep.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Ezrim challenges Anzrag while Kaya plans to use an evidence capsule.
timeline.quote: Ezrim was standing in the open space between the agent desks and the evidence pen

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya phases through Anzrag's blow and traps him in the capsule.
timeline.quote: The capsule chimed, an incongruously pleasant sound, before expanding into a massive bubble, trapping Anzrag inside.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Ezrim and Yarus confirm that Yarus did not free Anzrag, and Yarus thanks the Agency for sparing the god.
timeline.quote: Yarus didn't release Anzrag from the evidence capsule

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 8: Gods of Chaos" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan joins the Agency on Ravnica and earns high honors by stopping the god Anzrag.
timeline.quote: earned high honors by stopping the Gruul god Anzrag from rampaging across the Ninth District

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Kaya help return Anzrag to containment after he escapes.
timeline.quote: Kaya distracted the god while Kellan retrieved the capsule, and they returned him to containment.

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gruul god Anzrag is released and rampages through the Agency headquarters.
timeline.quote: the Gruul god Anzrag was released and rampaged through the Agency headquarters, killing multiple agents

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "Murders at Karlov Manor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After months of attempts, the Zhur-Taa druid Yarus summoned Anzrag, and giant mole tunnels were afterward found beneath the undercity.
timeline.quote: the Zhur-Taa druid Yarus was able to summon Anzrag

citation.text: "Anzrag", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A month before Murders at Karlov Manor, Anzrag broke loose of guild control and ravaged the Ninth District until investigators including Kellan contained him in an evidence capsule at Agency headquarters.
timeline.quote: Anzrag broke loose of guild control and wreaked havoc across the Ninth District

citation.text: "Anzrag", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anzrag was released the day after the attempted assassination of Aurelia, rampaged through the Agency headquarters killing at least four agents, and was recaptured by Kaya Cassir.
timeline.quote: He killed at least four agents and injured more before he could be recaptured by Kaya Cassir .

citation.text: "Anzrag", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ezrim challenges the escaped Anzrag before Kaya recaptures it.
timeline.quote: Ezrim challenged the god before it was recaptured by Kaya

citation.text: "Ezrim", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anzrag breaks loose of guild control and is stopped by the Agency.
timeline.quote: broke loose of guild control and was stopped by the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations

citation.text: "The Murders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anzrag escapes custody and rampages through Agency headquarters; Judith captures Agrus Kos to frame Rakdos.
timeline.quote: Judith captured Agrus Kos in an attempt to frame Rakdos

citation.text: "The Murders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
